facts.fact: According to Smartly.io's case study, Wolt has scaled its campaigns in over 100 cities using Smartly.io.
facts.quote: Smartly.io has helped us scale campaigns in over 100 cities

facts.fact: Smartly.io's case study states that Wolt saves 10 hours per week with Smartly.io.
Smartly.io's case study states that Wolt has a single source of truth for data through the Smartly.io and AppsFlyer integration.
facts.quote: single source of truth for data

facts.fact: The case study says Wolt partners with more than 36,000 restaurant and retail partners.
facts.quote: partnering with more than 36,000 restaurant and retail partners

facts.fact: The case study says Wolt was founded in Helsinki in 2015.
The case study says Wolt operates in 23 countries and more than 150 cities.
facts.quote: now operates in 23 countries and more than 150 cities

facts.fact: The case study lists Wolt's company size as 7000.
The Wolt case study was published on February 6, 2022.
